record.Description: These recalled products are packaged in a large clear plastic bag. A white label on the clear plastic bag has, in black font, one of the following identifiers: 6502 (for the light-up tie), HD-10 (for the light-up headbands) or L-508 (for the light-up glasses). Each of the items are packaged in individual clear plastic in the larger bag. A white label on the individual clear plastic bag has black lettering that reads: “MADE IN CHINA, Importer: ABC TRADING, INC.”
record.Title: ABC Trading Recalls Light-Up Children’s Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
record.ConsumerContact: ABC Trading toll-free at 323-581-3688 from 9:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. PT Monday through Friday, email at recallabc@gmail.com or online at https://www.abctradinginc.com/recall-2 or www.abctradinginc.com and click “Recall Information” at the top of the page for more information.

Products.Name: Light-Up Glasses, Crown Headbands, Sparkle Headbands and Ties

Recalled ABC Trading Light-Up Sparkle Headbands

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
ABC Trading stores in Los Angeles, California and other specialty stores nationwide and online at abctradinginc.com from September 2016 through May 2026 for about $1.

Importers.Name: ABC Trading Inc., of Vernon, California

Hazards.Name: The recalled children’s toys violate the mandatory standard for toys because they contain button cell batteries and the compartments that hold the batteries can be easily accessed by children, posing a deadly ingestion hazard to children. When button cell and coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death.

Remedies.Name:
Consumers should stop using the recalled light-up toys immediately and contact ABC Trading for a refund. Consumers will be asked to email recallabc@gmail.com a photograph showing the product being disposed of in the trash. 

Note: Button cell batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures.

ai.summary: ABC Trading has recalled various children's light-up toys, such as headbands, glasses, and ties, because the battery compartments can be opened too easily by children. This design flaw breaks toy safety rules and exposes kids to button cell batteries. Swallowing these batteries can lead to chemical burns, critical injuries, or death.
ai.next_steps: Stop using the recalled toys immediately and reach out to ABC Trading to get a refund. You will need to email a picture of the product in the trash to recallabc@gmail.com, and make sure to follow local hazardous waste guidelines when throwing away or recycling the button cell batteries.
